title: The European Robotic Spinal Instrumentation (EUROSPIN) Study
brief_summary: In a multinational prospective study, preoperative, intraoperative, perioperative and follow-up data on patients receiving thoracolumbar pedicle screw placement for degenerative disease or infections or tumors will be collected. The three arms consist of robot-guided (RG), navigated (NV), or freehand (FH) screw insertion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Informed consent
* Thoracolumbar pedicle screw placement
* Indication for surgery: Degenerative pathologies (stenosis, spondylolisthesis, degenerative disc disease, recurrent disc herniation), infections, tumors, fractures, trauma
* Age ≥ 18

Exclusion Criteria

* Deformity surgery
* \>5 index levels
study_population: Patients receiving thoracolumbar transpedicular screw placement for degenerative pathologies (stenosis, spondylolisthesis, degenerative disc disease, recurrent disc herniation), infections, fractures, trauma, or tumors.
